The data has only observed outcomes, so the average treatment effect on the control (ATC) has to be estimated. I fit a linear regression of the outcome on the covariates among treated children. I then predicted the treated outcome for each control child and averaged the difference from their observed outcome. That gives about 4.09.

As a cross-check, a single regression on treatment plus all covariates gives a treatment coefficient of about 3.93. I'm reporting the imputation estimate because it targets the controls specifically.

ANSWER: 4.09
